_comment: 2026-09-21 enlarged cube, same two tags: 2.1 m wide, 0.95-3.05 m from the tag door.
_bias_comment: 2026-09-23: the drone flies 30-50 cm above the altitude the runner tracks -- by the tags, by a range-free pixel-elevation reading, and by the operator's tape (~120 cm at a commanded 70). 45 is the planning figure, fitted together with coverage.HOVER_PITCH_DOWN_DEG = 5 deg against every 09-21/22/23 stop; the two trade off and only the pair is identifiable. Each flight calibrates its own offset from its first fix (cube.mission), so this is a starting point, not the truth of a flight.
